page.notes: Printed Arabic and transliterations copied as seen; the Arabic word after "&" (Elahat) and the Arabic of "Manab" are not fully clear: [?] not added because the forms are legible in the scan but should be checked. Italic/roman boundaries in the first paragraph and in the sentences "Et ob eandem causam..." and "Ideóque..." are uncertain and were set on best reading. The first paragraph begins with "sticorum" (long s); the scan's first letter looks like a ligature, so checking against the original is advised. Printed "Suratè l Nojm" and "Alcorano" retained as printed. Printed "Deo sc." bracket is a printer's insertion, kept. Printed letters "probibita" in the first paragraph appear as "prohibita" in the scan; kept as printed by reading "probibita" is an error; check against original.
